verdict.rationale: xAI documents a dedicated Structured Outputs capability that guarantees responses match a supplied schema when supported schema features are used. The grok-4.7 spec card lists "Structured outputs: Yes". The guarantee is qualified by "supported schema features", and the pack does not detail which schema features or SDK-typed helpers are available. missing for 10: documentation of supported schema features and limitations, typed SDK/native typed-answer details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get typed, structured outputs — JSON-schema-constrained responses or a natively typed answer format — so my code consumes model output without fragile parsing

citations.quote: When using supported schema features, the response is guaranteed to match your schema.
